title: Insulin duration not updating
body:
I've amended the insulin duration in the prediction menu from the default to 4.5 hours, however this does not update or show on the home screen when an insulin treatment is added.

Using Nov 2 build

comments.body:
Not seen any update on this, but the issue still remains.

When I've updated the insulin duration in the prediction settings, then log a treatment dose the insulin duration graph remains at the default duration length and not the updated one I've ever in the settings.

This is making it tricky for me to make predictions or measuring my IoB
